datasets.title: Colombia - PiN AdR Protección de la Niñez
datasets.description: Esta base contiene el resultado final del cálculo de las severidades, la Población en Necesidad (PiN) y las desagregaciones poblacionales para el Área de Responsabilidad de Protección de la Niñez, Colombia 2024.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/colombia-pin-adr-proteccion-de-la-ninez-2024]

lineage.description: This dataset presents the final calculated results of severity classifications and Population in Need (PiN) estimates for children requiring protection assistance in Colombia 2024, derived from multi-sectoral humanitarian needs assessment data disaggregated by gender, ethnicity, and disability status at administrative levels.
